description: Destroy the input-to-patch-effect matching while preserving the observed logit-effect distribution.
rq: Mechanism: does input-specific matching, especially direction matching, explain held-out repair?
hypothesis: DynaPatch works partly because different inputs receive different correction directions matched to their error modes.
falsifier: The median RR_held advantage of the original assignment over global reassignment is at most 0.02, or fewer than 24 of 36 cells exceed the null 97.5th percentile.
support_rule: Support if the median advantage is greater than 0.05 and at least 30 of 36 cells exceed the null 97.5th percentile.

data.population: Rows where the frozen base prediction is wrong.

compute.device: CPU analysis from saved logits; invocation pins CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0

stopping_rule: PROMOTE if the support rule passes; ABANDON the specialization mechanism if the falsifier fires; otherwise EXTEND with a classifier-weight-space test.
